messages:
Emma Ortega: Hi everyone! Im Emma, started today on Product Design. Remote from Berkeley but Ill be in the office a couple days each month. I collect vintage postcards and Im a very amateur stargazer 30c. Looking forward to meeting folks!
Nate Park: Welcome Emma!! :tada: Postcards = instant friend. Wheres your favorite postcard from?
Emma Ortega: Thanks Nate! I have a weird soft spot for old roadside postcards of diners and neon signs. Also Im low-key into matcha lattes 3753fb and would love recs for local spots.
Lydia Chen: Welcome!! Try Moonleaf on 4th for matcha, and the office kitchen has ceremonial-grade matcha powder in the cabinet if you want to make your own. We keep a little whisk in the tea drawer.
Marcus Li: Hi Emma 44b Theres a plant-swap happening this Friday at lunch if youre into tiny desk greenery. Also FYI badge lockers are row B, combos start with 2.
Emma Ortega: Ooh plant-swap and matcha in one week? Sign me up. Do people leave postcards around or is that odd?
Nate Park: Totally fine. We have a community shelf near the 2nd-floor lounge for freebies and swaps. Postcards would be adorable.
Lydia Chen: Quick poll: rooftop tea meetup next Thursday 5:30pm 3753fb vs coffee downstairs 6pm 3753fb? React with :tea: for tea or :coffee: for coffee.
Marcus Li: :tea: Ill bring a tiny portable kettle.
Emma Ortega: :tea: Ill bring a handful of postcards and a small star-chart print. If anyones into stargazing theres a weekend meetup group we sometimes coordinate with.
welcome-bot: Welcome message posted to #new-hires: "Say hi to Emma Ortega  Product Design  Berkeley/SF" :wave:
HR-bot: Reminder: dont forget to complete your benefits enrollment within 14 days. Link: https://intranet/benefits (auto-reminder).
Nate Park: Also pro tip: the bike pump lives in locker B-3 and the rooftop gets chilly at night 976 bring a light jacket.
Emma Ortega: Thanks everyone  excited to meet folks in person soon and trade postcards!"
